integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Connect your ad platforms and analytics destinations.
integrations.metaDesc: Connect your Meta Pixel for server-side conversion tracking
integrations.tiktokDesc: Send events server-side via TikTok Events API
integrations.ga4Desc: Send events to Google Analytics 4 via Measurement Protocol
integrations.klaviyoDesc: Forward browsing and purchase events to Klaviyo
integrations.redditDesc: Send server-side conversion events to Reddit Ads.
integrations.pinterestDesc: Send server-side conversion events to Pinterest Ads.
integrations.metaGuideStep1Desc: Go to business.facebook.com, navigate to Events Manager, and select your Pixel.
integrations.metaGuideStep2Desc: Your Pixel ID is the number displayed under your pixel name (e.g. 1234567890). Copy it and paste it in the Pixel ID field above.
integrations.metaGuideStep3Title: Generate a Conversions API Access Token
integrations.metaGuideStep3Desc: In Events Manager, go to Settings > Conversions API > Generate Access Token. Copy the token and paste it in the Access Token field above.
integrations.tiktokGuideStep1Desc: Go to ads.tiktok.com, navigate to Assets > Events > Web Events.
integrations.tiktokGuideStep2Desc: Select your pixel and copy the Pixel ID shown at the top of the page (e.g. CKXXXXXXXXXXXXXX).
integrations.tiktokGuideStep3Desc: In your pixel settings, go to Settings > Generate Access Token. Copy it and paste it in the Access Token field above.
integrations.ga4GuideStep1Desc: Go to analytics.google.com, click the gear icon (Admin), then select your property.
integrations.ga4GuideStep2Desc: Go to Data Streams > select your web stream. Your Measurement ID starts with G- (e.g. G-XXXXXXXXXX). Copy it.
integrations.ga4GuideStep3Desc: In the same stream details page, scroll down to Measurement Protocol API secrets > Create. Give it a name, copy the secret value, and paste it above.
integrations.klaviyoGuideStep1Desc: Go to klaviyo.com, click your account name > Settings > API Keys.
integrations.klaviyoGuideStep2Desc: Click Create Private API Key. Give it a name like 'Track Clear'. Set scope to Full Access for Events and Profiles.
integrations.klaviyoGuideStep3Desc: Copy the private API key (starts with pk_) and paste it in the API Key field above. You won't be able to see it again.
integrations.redditGuideStep1Desc: Go to ads.reddit.com and select your ad account.
integrations.redditGuideStep2Desc: Your Account ID (e.g. t2_xxxxx) is shown in the account switcher or URL. Copy it and paste it above.
integrations.redditGuideStep3Desc: Go to Events Manager > Conversions API > Generate Token. Copy it and paste it in the Access Token field above.
integrations.pinterestGuideStep1Desc: Go to ads.pinterest.com and navigate to Conversions > Set up the conversions API.
integrations.pinterestGuideStep2Desc: Your Ad Account ID is shown in the account settings or URL bar. Copy the numeric ID.
integrations.pinterestGuideStep3Desc: In the Conversions API setup, generate a new token. Copy it and paste it in the Conversion Token field above.
integrations.googleAdsDesc: Send server-side conversion events to Google Ads.
integrations.googleAdsGuideStep1Title: Create Conversion Actions in Google Ads
integrations.googleAdsGuideStep1Desc: Go to Google Ads > Goals > Conversions > New conversion action. Create one conversion action for each event you want to track (Purchase, Add to Cart, etc.).
integrations.googleAdsGuideStep2Desc: Your Conversion ID is the numeric part of the AW- tag (e.g. if your tag is AW-1234567890, the Conversion ID is 1234567890). You can find it in the tag setup instructions.
integrations.googleAdsGuideStep3Desc: Each conversion action has a unique label. Find it in the tag setup instructions for each action, then paste the label in the corresponding field above.
integrations.shopifyWebhookDesc: Catches purchases missed by the pixel (PayPal, off-site payments)
integrations.webhookSigningSecretPlaceholder: Paste the signing secret from Shopify
integrations.webhookGuideStep1Desc: Go to Shopify Admin > Settings > Notifications. Scroll down to the Webhooks section.
integrations.webhookGuideStep2Desc: Click Create Webhook. Select 'Order payment' as the event. Paste the Webhook URL shown above and click Save.
integrations.webhookGuideStep3Desc: After creating the webhook, Shopify displays a signing secret. Copy it and paste it in the Signing Secret field above, then click Save.
